articles.summary: Brookdale Senior Living, the nation’s largest publicly traded operator of senior living communities and third largest owner of senior living real estate, has been named to the 2026 America’s Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces® list, developed by Best Practice Institute (BPI) and featured in The Wall Street Journal.
articles.title: Brookdale Named One of America’s Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces® for 2026
